title: Midnight Laboratory Terminal
summary: A low-glare blue-black terminal palette with clear scientific status colors and a cool cyan cursor.
details: Midnight Laboratory Terminal keeps shell output quiet and structured during long computation sessions. Commands, paths, warnings, and successful checks remain distinct without turning the terminal into a neon display.
features: Low-glare blue-black background for long terminal sessions
Distinct success, warning, error, path, and prompt colors
Readable normal and bright ANSI palettes
Inert fixed colors with no scripts, fonts, or remote assets
